decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern elevations of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The rooflights in the extension hereby approved will be obscure glazed.

Condition : 6 - That before planning permission are issued, the applicants shall first enter into a Legal Agreement under Section 106 to ensure that the proposed works are built and completed at the same time, and that no part of the new development is used before the other party has completed the works also.

Condition : 7 - That subject to the satisfactory completion of the above legal agreement, the Director of Planning be authorised to issue planning permission for the development subject to the conditions below, for the following reason:
The application for the erection of a single storey side and rear extension, as shown on drawing numbers 636/PL/100, 636/PL/101, 636/PL/102, 636/PL/200, 636/PL/201 & 636/PL/202, received 15 August 2006, in accordance with an approved unilateral agreement, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the extension, by reason of its size, materials, design and location would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of the property at 46 Homefield Road, Chiswick. The extensions would not be detrimental to the surrounding properties. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and satisfactorily complies with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension to house.
